subject: general
question:
Which of the following statement(s) is/are true about the pressure exerted by fluids?

(i) Fluids exert pressure on the base and walls of the container in which they are enclosed.

(ii) Pressure exerted in any confined mass of fluid is transmitted unequally in different directions.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Only (i)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Statement (i):** "Fluids exert pressure on the base and walls of the container in which they are enclosed" is **correct**.

 
 
• Fluids, which include liquids and gases, exert pressure due to the random motion of their molecules.
 
• This pressure acts in all directions, including on the base and walls of any container they occupy.
 
• For example, water in a glass exerts pressure on the bottom and walls due to its weight and molecular motion.
 
 
 
• **Statement (ii):** "Pressure exerted in any confined mass of fluid is transmitted unequally in different directions" is **incorrect**.
 
 
• According to **Pascal's Law**, the pressure exerted in a confined fluid is transmitted equally in all directions.
